channel.title: SillyBaby: Blog
channel.description: The SillyBaby blog: practical, fact-checked posts for new and first-time parents on newborn days, sleep, feeding, seasonal care, gear and growing up.

item.title: Baby-led weaning: gagging vs choking, and how to keep mealtimes safe
item.description: Baby-led weaning explained: how gagging differs from choking, which foods to avoid, how to cut finger foods safely and what to do if a baby chokes.

item.title: Bronchiolitis in babies: what to look for, and when to get help
item.description: Bronchiolitis and RSV in babies: early signs, when to call 999 or 111, how to care for baby at home and the RSV vaccine in pregnancy (UK and US).

item.title: Button batteries and magnets: the hidden Christmas danger for babies and toddlers
item.description: Button batteries and strong magnets are hidden dangers in Christmas gifts and gadgets. Learn where they hide, how to store them and what to do if swallowed.

item.title: Car seats and winter coats: why puffy jackets and harnesses don't mix
item.description: Why bulky winter coats and snowsuits are unsafe under a car seat harness, how to check the fit, and warm alternatives for babies and toddlers in cold weather.

item.title: Winter baby care: cosy, safe and well
item.description: Winter baby care tips: dressing babies for cold weather, car seats and puffy coats, safe winter sleep, colds, bronchiolitis and when to see a doctor.

item.title: Colic: signs, soothing and coping
item.description: Is it colic? The signs of colic in babies, soothing techniques that may help, how to cope with a crying baby and when crying means you should call a doctor.

item.title: Your first week with a newborn
item.description: The first week with a newborn, day by day: feeding, nappies, weight, sleep, the baby blues and checks, plus warning signs that mean you should call for help.

item.title: Hospital bag checklist (that you will actually use)
item.description: A practical hospital bag checklist for labour and birth: what to pack for you, your baby and your birth partner, when to pack it, and the things you can skip.

item.title: TOG ratings explained: keeping baby cosy, not too hot
item.description: What TOG means on a baby sleep bag, how to match it to room temperature and clothing, sleep bag safety checks and why the room should be 16–20°C.
